subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lead-in: eating out; Listening 3.5.1 on favourite restaurants / Ordering paragraphs of a narrative essay and the stages of essay writing
outcomes: Talk and listen about eating out and restaurants
Put the paragraphs of a narrative essay in order
Know the eight stages of writing an essay

tf.s: 'Revise' means to change and improve your writing.
tf.why: Yes, revising makes a draft better.
Voice C likes buffets: they are good value and kids can eat a lot.

tf.s: Voice E thinks restaurants waste time and money.
tf.why: Right, that is why he prefers fast food.

tf.s: A takeaway is food you buy to eat somewhere else.
tf.why: Yes, you take it away with you.

tf.s: In a narrative essay, events should be in a logical order.
tf.why: Correct, a clear order makes it easy to read.

tf.s: 'Proofread' means reading through to correct mistakes.
tf.why: Yes, it is one of the last stages.

tf.s: You can hand in your first draft without any changes.
tf.why: A first draft always needs changes.

tf.s: The first stage of essay writing is proofreading.
tf.why: First you make sure you understand the title.

tf.s: Linking words can help you put paragraphs in order.
tf.why: Yes, words like 'He' refer back to earlier ideas.

tf.s: 'Draft' means the final, perfect form of a piece of writing.
tf.why: A draft is not yet in its final form.

boxes.q: What is Voice A looking for in a restaurant?
boxes.why: Voice A wants special food and good service.

boxes.q: Where did Voice D eat in Istanbul?
boxes.why: It was an ancient cistern built by the Romans.
You get a lot for what you pay.

boxes.q: What is the correct order of the paragraphs?
o: E, C, B, D, A, F
A, B, C, D, E, F
F, A, D, B, C, E
boxes.why: Paragraph E gives the background, so it comes first.

boxes.q: Which paragraph gives the general background?
What is the last stage of essay writing?
What makes an essay easy to read?
o: Events in a clear, logical order

boxes.q: Which stage comes right after the first draft?
What do groups discuss in Activity 1?
boxes.why: They discuss restaurants and ready-made meals.

boxes.q: What is Voice B looking for?
boxes.why: For Voice B, atmosphere matters most.

hunt.q: The feeling or mood of a place
Eat as much as you like
Food you buy to eat elsewhere
Writing not yet in final form

mcq.q: Why does Voice C like buffet restaurants?
o: They are good value and kids can eat as much as they want

mcq.q: Which list shows the stages of essay writing in the correct order?
o: Understand the title, gather ideas, plan, first draft, revise, final draft, proofread, hand in
Plan, hand in, first draft, understand the title, revise, proofread, gather ideas, final draft
First draft, hand in, plan, revise, gather ideas, final draft, proofread, understand the title
Proofread, plan, understand the title, hand in, gather ideas, revise, first draft, final draft
mcq.why: Start with the title and finish by handing in.

mcq.q: What should a good introduction to a narrative essay do?
o: Give background and catch the reader's attention
mcq.why: A good start makes people want to read.

mcq.q: In the essay, 'He' refers back to 'the chef'. How does this help you?
o: The paragraph with 'He' comes after the one that mentions the chef
The paragraph with 'He' must be first
It shows the essay has no order
mcq.why: Pronouns point back to earlier words.

mcq.q: You have just finished your first draft. What should you do next?
mcq.why: Revising comes after the first draft.

mcq.q: A family with many children wants good value. Which restaurant suits them best?
o: An expensive restaurant with special food
mcq.why: Like Voice C, they can eat as much as they want.

mcq.q: Why should students never hand in a first draft?
o: It always needs changes; nobody writes a perfect essay first time
mcq.why: Every writer improves a first draft.

mcq.q: Why is proofreading near the end of the writing stages?
o: You check small mistakes after the content is finished
You must proofread before you have ideas
It is the same as planning
mcq.why: Fix ideas first, then small errors.

mcq.q: Why does paragraph E come first in the essay?
o: It has the most linking words
mcq.why: Background sets the scene for the story.
